method: first sighting while converging; break = close beyond a line by 0.3 ATR within apex+5 bars (max 60); move over 10 bars in ATR; false break = a close back inside within 5 bars; frac = the break's place between the start and the apex; reach = the starting height added at the break touched within 30 bars; train = first 70% by date; null = the same walk on each ticker's returns shuffled (3x); edge = held-out expected-way share minus the null's, 5.0 points or more to count; #664 reach1 = 0.6 of the height; pullback = back to the line within 10 bars; chase / retest R to reach1 or a close 0.5 ATR inside the line within 30 bars; rules = no weak pattern, no late break (past 0.8 of the way to the apex)
